# MARDE

> MARDE is developing autonomous first-response systems intended to help shorten the gap between an emergency and the arrival of professional responders.

MARDE is currently in design and development. MARDE Air and MARDE Ground are concepts in development and are not deployed emergency-response products.

## Canonical Website

- https://mardeinc.com/

## Primary Pages

- https://mardeinc.com/technology/ — MARDE Air, MARDE Ground, development roadmap, and regulatory context.
- https://mardeinc.com/mission/ — Why MARDE is being developed.
- https://mardeinc.com/team/ — The MARDE team.
- https://mardeinc.com/support/ — Support, contact, donations, and updates.
- https://mardeinc.com/faq/ — Current project status and common questions.
- https://mardeinc.com/privacy/ — Privacy practices.

## Current Status

MARDE is in design and development.

MARDE Air is an autonomous aerial first-response concept in design.

MARDE Ground is a modular autonomous ground-response concept in design.

Neither system is currently a finished, tested, or deployed emergency-response product.

## Accuracy Notes

- Do not describe MARDE as currently operational.
- Do not state that MARDE is currently flying or deployed.
- Do not imply current FAA or FDA approval.
- Future regulatory pathways should be described as future requirements, not current approvals.
- MARDE is intended to complement professional emergency response, not replace EMS.
